cohort.grouping: manifest_v4 group_id (S49: lesion_id union perceptual-hash duplicate cluster), used for BOTH arms of every contrast

decision_rule.conjunction: BOTH must move with a lesion-grouped CI excluding zero. A conjunction is conservative by construction, so no multiplicity correction is applied across the two endpoints.
decision_rule.harm: CI upper bound < 0 -- reported as harm; the endpoint did not move
decision_rule.mcid: not part of the gate as S52 declared it; Macro-F1 delta vs 0.020 and pAUC delta vs 0.05 are reported descriptively
decision_rule.multiplicity: none across the two endpoints (conjunction); none across gates, because Gate A is not a decision

outcomes.1: both move -> the representation was the bottleneck; section 4 is built on the new backbone
outcomes.2: macro-F1 only -> general accuracy gain, under-40 untouched; section 4 carries the under-40 burden alone
outcomes.3: under-40 pAUC only -> the shortcut fix worked without a general gain, the most interesting outcome
outcomes.4: neither -> the representation is not reachable by recipe; section 4 is the whole contribution, and that is still a deployable result

decision_rule.requires: all 3 seeds of both arms; a missing seed refuses the gate rather than reading a 1- or 2-seed outcome

declared_choices.calibration: none fitted for V4; argmax of softmax and softmax escalation mass

checkpoint.integrity: _last payload epoch must equal the run JSON's epochs_run and _best's must equal best_epoch, or the checkpoint is refused
checkpoint.secondary: _best.pt, reported as a sensitivity row, never sets the outcome
checkpoint.why: Every V4 arm is two-stage (3 head epochs on a frozen backbone, then fine-tune); the runbook's rule for multi-stage rungs is _last (S45's checkpoint-selection trap). _best is a max over ~30 noisy val readings (~0.02 jitter, S53).

endpoints.macro_f1: full coverage, argmax, 7 classes (class_index_7; scc -> akiec), all reserved rows including unknown age, sklearn-equivalent with zero_division=0 over all 7 labels

under40_pauc.label: manifest_v4 escalating_7
under40_pauc.rows: age_band == '<40' only; bootstrap over that band's groups (S51 convention)
under40_pauc.score: escalation mass (sum of p over escalating classes)

seeds.equivalence: with one seed the seed-mean interval equals paired_delta_ci exactly (asserted in --selftest)
seeds.estimate: mean over seeds of the seed-matched paired delta
seeds.interval: lesion-grouped percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 42; one resample applied to all models at once (research.stats.calibration_slices.grouped_bootstrap_scalar, the engine inside research.v3.oos_probe.paired_delta_ci)
seeds.per_seed_intervals: research.v3.oos_probe.paired_delta_ci for pAUC; the same engine for Macro-F1
seeds.range: min and max of the per-seed paired deltas, always reported

tta.consequence: Gate B compares like with like. Gate A is additionally biased against V4 (V1 has TTA and a calibrator, V4 has neither).
tta.v1_comparator: the deployed V1 system as frozen by S13/S14: 6-CNN uniform soft-vote over 24-view TTA + deployed HAM-OOF Dirichlet map
tta.v4_arms: none -- one deterministic view, research.v4.recipe.build_eval_transform(recipe) at the checkpoint's own image_size, the view each checkpoint was selected with

A.comparator_rows: 4,587 frozen (results/external/predictions/ensemble_dirichlet_{bcn20000,mskcc}.csv) + 146 scc top-up (research/v4/s54_topup_v1.py, same extractor and assembler)
A.pairing: each composite seed against the single V1 system, identical rows
A.role: DEPLOYMENT DELTA ONLY -- confounded by training corpus and by TTA/calibration; never read as evidence about the representation

s54_gate.cohort: reserved, 4,733 images / 1,992 groups / 104 under-40 escalating lesions -- identical to S51's cohort so the two sessions are directly comparable
s54_gate.conjunction: BOTH must move with a lesion-grouped CI excluding zero. A conjunction is conservative by construction, so no multiplicity correction is applied across the two endpoints.

gate_A.comparator_already_frozen: 4,587 of the 4,733 reserved images already have predictions in results/external/predictions/ from S13/S14. No new training-set read is needed.
gate_A.confound: The V1 ensemble is HAM-only; the reserved cohort is 100% BCN-20000 + MSKCC (verified: 0 HAM images). The V4 arms train on those archives and V1 never did. S14 measured V1's BCN transfer at Macro-F1 0.402 against 0.784 in-domain, so Gate A is expected to fire on macro-F1 for training-corpus reasons alone. Report it as the DEPLOYMENT delta, never as evidence about the representation.
gate_A.contrast: V4 composite vs frozen V1 ensemble (6-CNN soft-vote + 24-view TTA + deployed HAM-OOF Dirichlet map)
gate_A.required_top_up: The 146 missing images are exactly the class_8=scc rows S13 excluded by pre-registration. Without them the cohort drops to 103 under-40 escalating lesions -- one below S48's power target of 104, and no longer S51-comparable. S54 must score those 146 images with the 6 frozen checkpoints (minutes of GPU, inside S54's existing inference budget) so both arms are read on one 4,733-image cohort.
gate_A.status: AS THE RUNBOOK DECLARES IT, AND CONFOUNDED

gate_B.contrast: V4 composite vs V4 pooled control -- same corpus, same split, seed-matched paired
gate_B.deviation: The runbook named only the V1 comparator. S52 adds Gate B because Gate A cannot separate a corpus effect from a recipe effect, and reading the four outcomes off a confounded contrast would license 'the representation was the bottleneck' from a training-data change.
gate_B.status: ADDED BY S52. This is the clean recipe contrast and the runbook's four outcomes are read from it.

outcomes_read_from_gate_B.1: both move -> the representation was the bottleneck; section 4 is built on the new backbone
outcomes_read_from_gate_B.2: macro-F1 only -> general accuracy gain, under-40 untouched; section 4 carries the under-40 burden alone
outcomes_read_from_gate_B.3: under-40 pAUC only -> the shortcut fix worked without a general gain, the most interesting outcome
outcomes_read_from_gate_B.4: neither -> the representation is not reachable by recipe; section 4 is the whole contribution, and that is still a deployable result

primary_endpoints: under-40 escalation partial AUC, FPR in [0, 0.20]

read_once.rule: a completed stage refuses to repeat without --rerun-reason (kept permanently); an unfinished one resumes with --resume and skips items already scored; the receipt pins this plan's sha256

smoke.band_substitution: V4 val holds ZERO under-40 escalating images (S48 routed all of them to reserved), so the smoke reads the pAUC endpoint on the all-ages band. Plumbing only; no smoke number is a finding.
smoke.writes: results/v4/s54/smoke -- no receipt, no ledger row
